name: conversation_loop_restore_user_after_reference_handoff
notes: Post-compaction user-ask restore. Harness links the repo's libjson and traces a faithful copy of conversation_loop_py_parity.c::agent_conversation_loop_restore_user_after_reference_handoff; twin drives LIVE _restore_user_after_reference_handoff with identical rung order (outcome-code value events + post-call message count). DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE (inputs excluded): (1) LIVE checks `not user_message.strip()` (whitespace-only rejected); C only rejects truly empty strings. (2) The already-restored rung: LIVE compares last-message content by VALUE, C by node pointer — pointer comparison never fires across independently parsed trees, so inputs with an exact duplicate tail would diverge and are excluded (a real semantic gap worth a follow-up).
